39859.summary: Dumped for being a poor monk, Zack hides a terrifying secret. He is actually a peerless Grandmaster and the Dragon Division boss. Playing a simple security guard, he crushes arrogant elites and wins a fiery cop's heart. When the martial world finally unites to destroy this nobody, who will be the first to beg for mercy?

44413.summary: Bullied and hunted as a Soulless, Raven is thrown into Fire Academy to die. Instead, she awakens mind control, turns her fate around—and makes Blake, the deadliest phoenix-fire heir, gentle only for her. A comeback in both power and love.
